sovereign_country.strategic_role: 亚太高客单价数字内容、游戏出海与本土电商合规

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Income-Generating Real Estate Property Portfolio Trust (REIT)

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Free Trade Agreement between the Republic of Korea and the United States of America (KORUS FTA)
Free Trade Agreement between the Republic of Korea and the European Union (Korea-EU FTA)
Convention between the Republic of Korea and the United States of America for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income
Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Korea and the Government of the Republic of Singapore on the Promotion and Protection of Investments

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Act on Reporting and Use of Specific Financial Transaction Information (Act No. 18645, as amended, effective 1 November 2024), Articles 2, 5-2, and 10, read with its Enforcement Decree (Presidential Decree No. 33141); Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea (Act No. 17662, as amended); the Real Estate Investment Company Act (Act No. 19052, as amended); the Trust Business Act (Act No. 17783, as amended); and KoFIU beneficial ownership reporting regulations promulgated thereunder.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Seoul Central District Court, Corporate Registry Division
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarisation by a South Korean notary public, followed by an Apostille certificate from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea when the destination State is party to the Hague Apostille Convention. If the destination is not a member, the notarised document must be legalised by the Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs and then by the consulate of the destination State. The Hague Apostille and consular legalisation are parallel alternatives and must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Active Corporate Registration Status Certificate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Supreme Court of Korea Electronic Registration Information System (certified extract)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified electronic copy issued by the Supreme Court of Korea; notarisation by a Korean notary; Apostille by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Korea for all Apostille Convention member States. For a non-member destination, use MOFA authentication followed by diplomatic legalisation at the foreign mission in Seoul. The two routes are mutually exclusive alternatives and may not be combined.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney for Incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the pre-incorporation entity / founding shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Execution before a Korean notary public; Apostille by the Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs for Apostille Convention destinations; Consular legalisation by the destination State embassy in Seoul for non-member States. Apostille and consular legalisation are mutually exclusive; under no circumstances may both be applied to the same document.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Memorandum of Establishment
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Founding members, as certified by the registering court
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Signed and sealed before a Korean notary; then Apostille by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs under the Hague Convention. For non-convention States, the notarised document is authenticated by MOFA and then legalised by the relevant consulate. The path is selected based solely on the destination State membership status and never chains apostille with legalisation.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Shinhan Bank or KEB Hana Bank, Corporate Banking Department
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank officer signature and bank seal notarised; Apostille by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for Hague States; non-Hague destinations require MOFA authentication and then consular legalisation. These are alternative paths; do not stack.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All proposed ultimate beneficial owners, directors, senior managers and transaction counterparties must be screened against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the United Kingdom Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation List, and the Republic of Korea domestic sanctions list administered by the Korean Financial Intelligence Unit under the Financial Transaction Reporting Act. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for all politically exposed persons and their immediate family, close associates and co-trustees; at least two independent sources must verify the source of wealth and source of funds for any PEP maintaining more than 10 percent ownership. Continuous FATF-style risk monitoring applies for the duration of the business relationship, including real-time transactional screening and negative news alerts.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea, Act No. 12102, as amended, Part III, Chapter I, Articles 287 through 317 (limited liability company/yuhan hoesa), including Articles 54, 55 and 289 regarding registration, legal seat, and corporate name; together with the Real Estate Investment Company Act, Act No. 16022, as last amended, Articles 8, 9, 11 and 16, and the Enforcement Decree of the Real Estate Investment Company Act, as applicable to the REIT authorization sought after incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Corporate Registration Section of the Local District Court Registry Office, which operates under the Supreme Court of Korea and has territorial jurisdiction over the registered office of the company.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of Incorporation of a Yuhan Hoesa (Limited Liability Company) submitted to the court registry, together with the notarized Articles of Incorporation, capital deposit certificate, consent declarations of the first manager and auditor, corporate seal registration data, and all statutorily required annexes.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: For the Yuhan Hoesa at Stage 2, the Commercial Act prescribes no minimum paid-up capital; however, the total contribution stated in the Articles of Incorporation must be fully subscribed and actually paid in before incorporation registration. The paid-in capital must be placed in a blocked capital subscription escrow account at a licensed bank in Korea, and the bank must issue a deposit certificate expressly blocking withdrawal until the court registry issues the certificate of incorporation registration. If the entity is later authorized as a real estate investment company under the Real Estate Investment Company Act, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport will impose a separate minimum equity requirement in the authorization order, and that equity must remain unencumbered and supported by the same escrow or blocked-account confirmation until the REIT license is issued.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF YUHAN HOESA (LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY), ADOPTED IN WRITING BY THE SOLE INITIAL MEMBER AND THE INITIAL MANAGER PURSUANT TO THE COMMERCIAL ACT OF THE REPUBLIC OF KOREA. RESOLVED, that the initial authorized and subscribed share capital of the Company, as set forth in the notarized Articles of Incorporation, is hereby accepted, ratified, and affirmed in full. The statutory officers appointed as first manager and first auditor, if any, confirm that each contribution has been paid in money or in kind in the exact amount stated in the certificate of capital subscription, and that no contribution is fictitious, unreleased, conditional, or otherwise defective under Korean law. The initial member and manager shall ensure that all subscriptions are credited to the blocked capital escrow account and that no withdrawal is made before the court registry issues the certificate of incorporation registration. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company, as fixed in the Articles of Incorporation, is adopted as the sole legal seat and principal administrative center of the Company, and the first manager is directed to file the registered office notification with the competent district court registry, to post any required corporate sign at the registered office, and to make all necessary filings with the National Tax Service and the relevant local government offices. RESOLVED FURTHER, that a corporate operating account titled Yuhan Hoesa Capital and Operating Account shall be opened with a bank duly licensed in the Republic of Korea. The initial capital deposit held in the blocked escrow account shall remain frozen until the certificate of incorporation registration has been obtained; immediately after registration, the bank shall release the blocked funds to the operating account. The first manager, jointly with any co-signer authorized by the Board, is authorized to execute account documentation, receive deposits, disburse funds for ordinary operating expenses, and establish wire transfer and dividend distribution procedures that comply with banking due diligence and anti-money laundering obligations. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the persons named in the appointment declarations attached to the incorporation filing are appointed as the first manager and statutory auditor of the Company, with full authority, within the limits of the Commercial Act, to represent the Company in all dealings, to affix the registered corporate seal, to negotiate and sign contracts, and to engage legal, tax, audit, and property management service providers. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the first manager shall execute all filings required for the REIT authorization of the Company under the Real Estate Investment Company Act, including the filing of the business registration certificate, corporate tax registrations, financial institution notifications, and any civil defense, environmental, fire safety, or occupational safety declarations applicable to the registered office. RESOLVED FURTHER, that all lawful actions taken by the first manager or the sole initial member prior to the date of this resolution, including opening of escrow accounts, execution of lease agreements for the registered office, and preparation of regulatory filings, are hereby ratified, confirmed, and adopted as acts of the Company. This Board Resolution shall remain in full force and effect until revoked or amended by a subsequent resolution, and shall not be construed as modifying the liability limitations applicable to the Company under Part III, Chapter I of the Commercial Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Incorporation Name Reservation, Foreign Investment Notification, and Registered Office Determination
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Supreme Court Internet Registration Office (electronic corporate registration portal), the designated local district court registry, and a designated foreign exchange bank or the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy for foreign investment reporting.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a name search against the Supreme Court corporate registration database and reserve the proposed corporate name for the Yuhan Hoesa by submitting the corporate name reservation application through the official e-registry. If any initial member is a non-resident, file a foreign investment report with the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy or a designated foreign exchange bank under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act, attaching evidence of lawful remittance or inward contribution. Identify the registered office address and confirm that the selected address falls within the territorial jurisdiction of the district court registry that will receive the incorporation registration application. This step fixes the identity, ownership, and venue for the subsequent filing and ensures that the intended corporate name and foreign ownership structure are legally available.
required_dossiers: Corporate name reservation application
Certified passport or national identity card of each incorporator or member
Foreign investment report or certificate of completion of foreign investment reporting, if applicable
Proposed Articles of Incorporation
Power of attorney if an agent is appointed
Proof of right to use the registered office address (lease agreement or title deed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is refused because of similarity to an existing registered mark or corporate name, the incorporator shall amend the proposed name and re-file the name reservation immediately, with the curative fee covered by the filing party. If the foreign investment report is queried, the applicant must respond to the designated bank or ministry within ten business days with supplementary source-of-funds evidence; if the report is rejected, the applicant may re-file through the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency with corrected ownership declarations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Approval, and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation and Capital Escrow
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Korean notary public (appointed under the Notary Public Act) and a bank licensed in Korea under the Financial Services Commission for the blocked capital subscription escrow account.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation containing the corporate name, corporate object clauses including growth and management of income-generating real property, authorized contribution value, contribution method, registered office, duration of the company, representation rules, and the names of the first manager and auditor. The sole initial member shall subscribe for all contributions, approve the draft, and sign the Articles in writing. The Articles must then be notarized before a Korean notary public, who will verify the identity and legal capacity of the subscriber. After notarization, open a temporary capital escrow account at a licensed bank in Korea and deposit the full subscription amount. Obtain a capital deposit certificate from the bank expressly stating that the funds are blocked until the company registration certificate is issued, because Korean law requires proof of full payment before the registry may enter the entity.
required_dossiers: Draft and final Articles of Incorporation
Subscription and contribution schedule
Certificate of capital subscription from the sole member
Deposit certificate from the bank evidencing the blocked capital escrow account
Identification documents of the first manager and auditor
Consent declarations of the first manager and auditor
Power of attorney for notarization if executed by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary refuses notarization due to any defect in the proposed Articles, the Articles shall be revised and resubmitted on the same day after the defect is cured. If the bank fails to issue an unconditional blocked deposit certificate, the incorporator must execute a revised escrow agreement containing a court-order blocking clause and obtain a corrected certificate; if the bank query concerns identity, the incorporator shall provide certified identification and a legal entity client questionnaire within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Institution of Incorporation Registration at the Local District Court Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local District Court Registry Office with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office, acting through the Supreme Court Commercial Registry System.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Articles have been notarized and the capital deposit has been confirmed, file the Application for Registration of Incorporation with the competent registry office. The application must be accompanied by the notarized Articles, the blocked capital deposit certificate, written declarations of appointment by the first manager and auditor, seal registration declarations, and the required identification and residence certificates of the incorporators and appointees. The registry will examine the legality of the Articles, the validity of the object clauses, the sufficiency of the capital subscription, and the authority of the signatories. Upon approval, pay the applicable corporate registration license tax, education surtax, and court filing fee. The registry will then issue the certified Commercial Register extract and the certificate of incorporation registration, at which point the Yuhan Hoesa exists as a juristic person.
required_dossiers: Application for Registration of Incorporation of a Limited Liability Company
Notarized Articles of Incorporation
Blocked capital deposit certificate
Statement of subscription and contribution payment
Consent declarations of first manager and auditor
Certificate of registered seal or power of attorney
Certified identification documents of all incorporators
Receipt for payment of registration tax and education surtax
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a supplementary order requesting further evidence or correction, the applicant must cure the stated defects within the period set by the registry, normally two weeks, by filing a corrected instrument. If the registration is refused, the applicant may initiate an administrative litigation before the local district court within 90 days from the date of refusal, with the assistance of licensed Korean counsel, and may also file a new application after correcting the offending clause.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: National Tax Service Business Registration, Seal Registration, and Release of Blocked Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: District Tax Office under the National Tax Service, the local court registry for seal filing, and the licensed bank holding the blocked capital escrow account.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the certified certificate of incorporation registration, file the Business Registration Certificate application with the district tax office within the statutory deadline from the date of commencement of business. Report the corporate name, registered office, representative, statutory business purpose of real estate investment trust activities and any other taxable operation, and the opening of the corporate operating account. The National Tax Service will issue the Business Registration Certificate and corporate tax number. Submit the certificate to the bank together with the certificate of incorporation registration and written instruction of the first manager to release the blocked escrow deposit into the corporate operating account. Register the corporate seal with the registry and obtain electronic tax invoices and corporate use bank facilities, while also updating any foreign investment report with the post-incorporation details of the company.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation registration issued by the court registry
Business Registration application form
Copy of Articles of Incorporation
Certificate of registered corporate seal
Power of attorney for tax agents
Identification of the first manager and auditor
Bank account instruction forms and bank due diligence questionnaire
Copy of foreign investment report, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the National Tax Service returns the application for correction, the agent shall cure the noted omissions, such as missing annexes or jurisdictional address discrepancies, and resubmit within the statutory correction period, normally ten days. If the bank refuses to release the escrowed funds due to insufficient corporate documentation, the manager shall deliver the official Business Registration Certificate and a certified copy of the court registry record, and provide separate instruction under the company seal; if the bank still refuses, the company may seek a court order for deposit release.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation REIT Authorization and Civil Defense and Occupational Premises Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT) Real Estate Investment Division, local fire safety station, and Korea Occupational Safety and Health Agency or local labor office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before commencing revenue-generating real estate investment trust operations, submit a written REIT authorization application to MOLIT under Article 9 of the Real Estate Investment Company Act. Attach the certified Commercial Register extract, the Articles of Incorporation, the final capital structure and proof of paid-in capital, the organizational chart, the property acquisition and management plan, dividend distribution policy, and the corporate AML/compliance manual. Demonstrate that the company has a credible acquisition strategy and will hold income-generating real property for the benefit of investors. In parallel, submit the registered office lease or structural occupancy documents to the local fire station for issuance of a fire safety certificate, including inspection of the evacuation route and firefighting equipment. Then obtain the workplace safety verification or business premises occupational clearance from the local labor office under the Occupational Safety and Health Act, confirming that the office premises meet electrical, structural load, and fire prevention standards.
required_dossiers: REIT authorization application submitted to MOLIT
Certified Commercial Register extract
Notarized Articles of Incorporation
Proof of paid-in capital and bank blocked account confirmation
Property acquisition plan or indicative asset portfolio
Conflict of interest and fiduciary compliance policies
Financial statements or pro-forma projections
Fire safety certificate and building inspection report for the registered office
Occupational safety and health act compliance declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOLIT issues a supplemental information request, the applicant shall respond within the period stated in the request, ordinarily one month, with revised plans or additional asset evidence. If REIT authorization is denied, the company may submit an administrative appeal to the central administrative appeals commission and thereafter file an administrative lawsuit before the Seoul Administrative Court within the statutory limitations period. If the fire or labor office refuses the premises clearance, the manager shall remedy the physical defects, schedule reinspection, and continue to hold the corporate entity dormant to avoid any unauthorized business operation penalties.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT) Real Estate Investment Division for REIT authorization, together with the local municipal government, local fire station, and Korea Occupational Safety and Health Agency for the registered office premises.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Authorization to Operate as a Real Estate Investment Company / REIT License issued under Article 9 of the Real Estate Investment Company Act, subject to any additional public offering registration or asset disposition permits required by MOLIT and the Financial Services Commission.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment of the Republic of Korea, Korea Environment Corporation, and the local municipal environmental bureau with jurisdiction over the registered office and underlying asset sites.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from a full Environmental Impact Assessment at Stage 2 because the ISIC 6499 real estate investment trust performs office-based financial administration rather than physical manufacturing, chemical, assembly, or warehousing activity. If the REIT later undertakes a construction or land-development project, the threshold classifications under the Environmental Impact Assessment Act will apply, requiring a Full EIA for large projects, a Prior Environmental Review for medium projects, and a simple Environmental Registration or exemption for small or low-impact projects, to be determined by the Ministry of Environment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: The REITs own administrative office generates no process wastewater, no point-source air emissions, and no volatile organic compound discharge; office sanitary sewage is disposed of through the municipal sewer system, and any discharge from the office premises to public waters would be required to meet the Clean Water Conservation Act effluent standards, including BOD concentrations not exceeding 40 mg/L, total suspended solids not exceeding 40 mg/L, and pH within 5.8 to 8.5. The REIT is expected to have zero industrial VOC emissions from its own operations; if hazardous waste is generated by any ancillary office activity, it must be stored for no more than 30 days, transferred by a licensed hazardous waste carrier, and documented by manifests retained for at least three years. All underlying real estate tenants shall independently hold their environmental operating permits, and the REIT shall covenant in its property management agreements that no tenant may operate an unpermitted emission source on the property.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: A fire safety certificate must be obtained from the local fire station for the registered office, certifying that the firefighting equipment, emergency exits, evacuation signage, and alarm systems comply with the Firefighting Facilities Installation and Maintenance Act. A structural load inspection and building operating certificate must confirm that the office premises safely accommodate the number of employees and electronic equipment. The workplace must also be cleared under the Occupational Safety and Health Act through a labor office inspection that covers electrical safety, fall prevention, confined spaces, and general accident-prevention measures. These certifications must be posted at the registered office and renewed at each renovation, lease renewal, or official inspection interval prescribed by the local authority.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: National Tax Service (NTS) of the Republic of Korea; online electronic portal: HomeTax (hometax.go.kr)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Determine whether the foreign non-resident entity maintains a domestic place of business in Korea under the Corporate Tax Act. A foreign REIT holding Korean income-generating real property either directly or through a domestic trust generally has a fixed place of business in Korea. Step 2: If a domestic place of business exists, the foreign entity must appoint a domestic tax representative and file a Foreign Corporation Domestic Place of Business Registration with the competent district tax office. Supporting documents include: certificate of incorporation and trust deed or articles of incorporation, certificate of foreign registration, power of attorney in favor of the Korean tax representative, evidence of Korean real estate ownership or lease/trust relationship, and proof of REIT license or authorization under the Real Estate Investment Company Act. Step 3: Upon approval, the district tax office issues a 10-digit Korean Business Registration Number, which operates as the corporate TIN and VAT identification number. Step 4: If the foreign non-resident entity does not have a domestic place of business but supplies VAT-able electronic services to Korean consumers, it must complete the simplified foreign business VAT registration through the HomeTax portal and obtain a simplified VAT registration number. Step 5: A foreign REIT with Korean-source income but no domestic place of business must still appoint a Korean tax representative for filing corporate tax and withholding obligations. Step 6: For VAT refund or direct pay purposes, the foreign entity may separately register as a registered foreign business where the Value-Added Tax Act grants that right.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None for US-style check-the-box entity classification because Korea does not offer check-the-box elections. However, a qualifying Korean REIT may elect the special tax treatment provisions under the Restriction of Special Taxation Act and the Real Estate Investment Company Act, which permit a deduction for mandatory dividend distributions from corporate taxable income subject to statutory distribution ratios and other qualification conditions. Such election does not change the entity-level taxation classification of the Yuhan Hoesa limited liability company.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) under the Value-Added Tax Act and its Enforcement Decree
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general VAT registration threshold applies to corporations; every corporation engaged in business in Korea is required to register. A simplified VAT taxpayer regime is available only to eligible individual businesses whose annual taxable turnover is below KRW 80 million, and this regime does not apply to a Yuhan Hoesa LLC or a REIT. Foreign suppliers of electronic services must register for Korean VAT regardless of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Korea mandates electronic tax invoices for B2B supplies. Tax invoices must be transmitted to the NTS through the HomeTax electronic tax invoice system, generally by the day after issuance. The system does not use physical pre-approval or fiscal stamping; instead, NTS operates a centralized data matching and risk-scoring platform that reconciles electronic tax invoices with cash receipts, bank settlements, and customs declarations. Businesses must use NTS-approved API, EDI, or HomeTax direct filing protocols and digital certificate authentication. Failure to issue or transmit an electronic tax invoice exposes the seller to statutory penalty surcharges.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export goods qualify for the 0% VAT rate when the goods are physically exported from Korea and evidenced by an export declaration accepted by the Korea Customs Service, with risk and possession transferred to a foreign buyer and the export payment received in foreign currency or Korean won in accordance with the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act. Services and intangibles qualify for zero-rating only when they fall within the statutory categories under the Value-Added Tax Act Enforcement Decree, including services or digital content supplied to a non-resident client that are actually used outside Korea. A Korean REIT supply of Korean real property or lease of Korean real estate is a domestic supply subject to 10% VAT and cannot be zero-rated because the place of supply and use are in Korea.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (export Bill of Entry / proof of export) issued by the Korea Customs Service
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export and matching the export declaration
Commercial invoice, packing list, and signed export contract or purchase order
Inward Remittance Certificate / Foreign Exchange Bank settlement certificate issued by a Korean foreign exchange bank evidencing receipt of sales proceeds from the foreign buyer
For exported services or intangibles: signed service supply contract, documentation of overseas use, and foreign currency settlement certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Where the NTS disallows an export zero-rating claim because the statutory documentation bundle is incomplete, false, or inconsistent, the supply is recharacterized as a domestic taxable supply and reassessed at the standard 10% VAT. The taxpayer will be liable for late payment surcharges and statutory additional taxes, which can range from 40% to 100% of the understated VAT depending on whether the deficiency is attributable to negligence or deliberate fraud. Where intentional false export declarations are used to obtain a VAT refund, the NTS may claw back the full refunded amount together with input VAT reversals and refer the matter to prosecution under the Punishment of Tax Crimes Act evading tax duties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Bank of Korea (BOK), acting with the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MOEF) under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act and the Foreign Investment Promotion Act
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: South Korea operates a fundamentally liberalized and largely convertible foreign exchange regime for current-account transactions, while capital-account transactions remain subject to mandatory reporting, notification, or licensing through authorized foreign exchange banks and the Bank of Korea. The Korean won is freely convertible into foreign currencies for trade, dividend remittance, and foreign direct investment, but every transaction must be reported or handled via a bank that is designated as a foreign exchange bank. For a non-resident-owned Yuhan Hoesa real estate investment trust, the main convertibility concern is not the is not the existence of surrender requirements but the need to satisfy the real-demand rule and documentary evidence for every cross-border transfer. Foreign capital injected for the REIT must be declared under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act, and subsequent profit distributions and capital repatriations can be converted through a domestic bank provided that corporate tax, withholding tax, and foreign exchange reporting obligations are settled. There is no dual exchange rate and no restriction on the remittance of net profits for an entity with proper statutory audit and tax clearance, but the bank will impose an enhanced review when the underlying investments are real estate because of money-laundering typologies involving asset value manipulation and shell holding structures.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds must be collected and settled through a Korean foreign exchange bank within 18 months of the export declaration date under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act. There is no mandatory conversion ratio into Korean won; exporters may retain the foreign currency proceeds in a foreign-currency corporate account or convert them at the market rate. Any extension beyond the statutory deadline requires prior notification or approval from the Ministry of Economy and Finance, depending on the reason for the delay.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Korean Won Business Operating Account plus Foreign Currency Current Account
Foreign Investor Capital Escrow Account and Foreign Currency Demand Deposit
Designated Foreign Exchange Bank Settlement Account
Corporate KRW Settlement Account and USD Clearing Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMI and fintech platforms are not viable as the primary treasury or clearing rail for a Korean-resident entity. Under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, only domestic banks designated as foreign exchange banks may perform Korean won conversion, foreign exchange reporting, and foreign investment registration services. Non-bank electronic financial businesses are not licensed to operate as foreign exchange banks for resident corporates, and they cannot legally open KRW deposit accounts, issue foreign-investment registration certificates, or act as settlement banks for dividend remittances and capital repatriation. A fintech EMI is therefore limited to a supplementary expense-card or invoice-correspondence role, and the treasurer should reject any attempt to route staging or disbursement liquidity through an unregulated offshore platform because the Korean bank would reject the downstream funds as non-compliant with source-of-funds rules.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Korean banks generally require the physical appearance of at least one signatory, usually the statutory director or the foreign investor, at a domestic branch to complete the corporate account opening interview and sign the specimen-card forms. Remote consular-proxy opening may be accepted on a discretionary basis when the power of attorney is notarized in the investor's home country, apostilled or consular-legalized, translated into certified Korean, and accompanied by passport copies and corporate registry extracts. In practice, the highest onboarding success rate is achieved when the registered director or an authorized senior officer travels to Seoul for the in-branch interview, because the bank's compliance committee will otherwise demand additional genuine-control documentation for a non-resident real estate trust.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholder chain with multitiered holding companies or trust-nominee layers obscuring the ultimate beneficial owner
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificates of incorporation and certificates of incumbency for every entity in the ownership chain, updated register of members, passport copies of all natural-person UBOs, source-of-wealth statements, three years of audited financial statements from each material shareholder, a written UBO declaration confirming no undisclosed nominee, and a legal opinion mapping ownership to physical persons.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds for the initial real estate capital injection is not supported by verifiable track record
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three-to-six months of pre-funding bank statements in the investor's name at a reputable bank, audited financial statements or certified net-worth statement, executed real estate purchase agreement or binding memorandum of understanding, independent third-party appraisal of the target property, board resolution approving the contribution amount, and the wire instruction from the originating bank showing the investor's account as the sole remitter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Adverse media, PEP status, or historical sanction exposure involving the Korean resident director or a major shareholder
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed know-your-customer questionnaire, national criminal-record certificate and court search from the Republic of Korea, bankruptcy registry search, PEP status explanation and a detailed source-of-wealth narrative, negative-news search results from the bank's designated screening tool, and an enhanced due diligence report prepared by a licensed compliance consultant.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Discrepancy between the declared REIT business purpose and proposed large related-party or round-trip transactions between Korea and foreign affiliates
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Annual business plan and cash-flow forecast for the real estate portfolio, REIT or operating trust prospectus, board minutes approving the related-party transaction, rental schedule and lease agreements supporting income generation, recent audited NAV statement and tax filings including corporate tax and withholding certificates, and an independent legal opinion confirming that the entity is not a shell or pass-through arrangement.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Investors must remit share capital or subscription proceeds by SWIFT from their originating bank directly to the Korean entity's foreign-currency account at an authorized domestic foreign exchange bank. Before the remittance, the foreign exchange bank must receive a foreign direct investment notification on the appropriate FDI report so that the entity obtains a Foreign Investment Registration Certificate under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act. The bank will assign the official foreign exchange transaction purpose code for foreign direct investment and record the capital transfer in the Foreign Exchange Information System. After settlement, the bank converts the USD or other foreign currency into Korean won at the market rate, and an external CPA verifies the paid-in capital against the bank receipt and the issued certificate. The verified capital may then be released for the purchase or development of income-generating real estate assets, but every disbursement must be traceable to the registered purpose of the real estate investment trust.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade and real-estate disbursements should be executed through domestic corporate internet banking using SWIFT MT103 for ordinary property acquisition payments and high-value wire transfers. For larger construction or escrow-type transactions, the Korean buyer should issue an irrevocable documentary letter of credit or use documentary collections with title documents through a domestic bank to ensure that payment occurs only upon presentation of compliant shipping or closing documents. Dividend payments to foreign shareholders are made by SWIFT MT103 with the foreign exchange purpose code for direct investment income remittance, accompanied by the bank's withholding certificate and evidence that the dividend was approved by the board and disclosed to tax authorities. All outward remittances are blocked at the bank system level unless an underlying transaction document, contractual invoice, closing statement, or tax certificate is pre-attached to the payment instruction.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore KRW/USD deliverable forward contracts with a domestic foreign exchange bank under real-demand underlying exposure
Cross-currency swaps for long-term foreign-currency liabilities of the real estate investment trust
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) permitted only through a domestic foreign exchange bank where the Korean entity proves real underlying foreign exchange exposure to property income or debt service
Structured forwards or currency options in limited combinations provided they are backed by a confirmed revenue or expenditure stream and are not used for prohibited speculative trading

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ordinary General Meeting of Members and approval of annual financial statements, external audit report and director re-election
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company statutory records maintained at the registered office in South Korea; no direct government filing authority for the meeting itself
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year REIT on 31 December, the meeting must be held by 31 March of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Directors may incur administrative fines under the Commercial Act; continued failure to hold the annual meeting can support a judicial dissolution petition by members and creates governance non-compliance that impairs the licensed REIT status

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and reconciling financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Tax Service of South Korea
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March following the fiscal year-end; an automatic one-month extension to 30 April applies when the return is prepared and signed by a licensed tax agent (Korean tax attorney)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing and deficient filing surcharges under the Framework Act on National Taxes: 20% additional tax for non-filing, 10% for underreporting, plus daily overdue interest of 0.022% on unpaid corporate tax; persistent delinquency can trigger enforced tax seizure, business account freeze and in the REIT context administrative revocation action

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements, audit report and annual business report under the Real Estate Investment Company Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the Korea Real Estate Investment Trust Association
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year-end; for a 31 December close, on or before 31 March, unless the REIT approval certificate imposes an earlier filing date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative order requiring correction, monetary penalty of up to KRW 30 million under the REIT Act; repeated failure over two consecutive business years can lead to revocation or forfeiture of the REIT license and an administrative or court-ordered dissolution of the entity

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner confirmation and investor/unit-holder register update for REIT investors
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Supervisory Service through the Real Name Financial Transactions registration and capital markets disclosure system, backed by the corporate register at the Yuhan Hoesa registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual beneficial-ownership confirmation by the AGM date or 31 March, whichever is earlier; any transfer of a beneficial interest or shareholding change in a REIT must be reported within 30 days of the transaction, and holders reaching 5% or more of the relevant class must disclose within 5 business days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties under the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act and the Act on Real Name Transactions; failure to file can suspend transfer effects and registration of the new holder and trigger administrative monetary fines, and in aggravated circumstances can support regulatory cancellation of the REIT registration

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent certified CPA audit is mandatory for every Korean REIT under the Real Estate Investment Company Act regardless of total assets. In addition, under the Act on External Audit of Stock Companies, a Korean corporate entity with total assets of KRW 12 billion or more as of the preceding fiscal year-end is required to appoint an independent auditor and submit audited financial statements. Korea does not use headcount or turnover as a standalone statutory audit trigger for this class of entity; the decisive quantitative trigger for non-listed non-REIT companies is the KRW 12 billion balance-sheet threshold adjusted under the External Audit Act, while a licensed REIT is subject to mandatory audit irrespective of size.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Korean IFRS as adopted by the Republic of Korea; supplemental compliance with the Act on External Audit of Stock Companies and the REIT accounting guidance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. Private non-listed entities may use the Small/Medium-Sized Entity Standard under Korean GAAP only when not being a REIT, but a licensed REIT must prepare full Korean IFRS financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: South Korea operates a real-name registration system for financial investment products and corporate members. A licensed REIT structured as a Yuhan Hoesa must keep a complete member or unit-holder register, and every investor is subject to annual beneficial-owner re-confirmation at the ordinary general meeting cycle. Direct or indirect transfers of memberships or beneficial interests must be entered in the statutory register and reported to the Financial Supervisory Service within 30 days of the legal transfer date; any holder whose direct or indirect ownership crosses 5% of the REIT equity or voting rights must additionally submit a large-holder disclosure within 5 business days. Failure to maintain the confirmation protocol exposes the management to penalties and can make the transfer ineffective against the company.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Charges and Mortgages over REIT assets
Minute Book of general meetings and board meetings

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24% maximum marginal CIT rate; progressive schedule 9% up to KRW 200 million taxable income, 19% up to KRW 20 billion, 21% up to KRW 300 billion, 24% above KRW 300 billion
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holiday. A qualifying REIT may benefit from the corporate income tax deduction for distributed income: if at least 90% of distributable REIT income is paid as dividends within the statutory distribution period, the distributed amount is deductible in computing taxable income, effectively reducing the REIT's Korean CIT burden to approximately retained-only earnings. Additional limited credits may apply under the Special Tax Treatment Control Law, such as R&D, investment, job creation, and ESG-linked tax incentives.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 10 Corporate Tax Return (Corporate Tax Base and Tax Computation Statement) filed through the National Tax Service HomeTax electronic filing system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final return plus two interim pre-payment returns per fiscal year for domestic corporations.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Final return: within 3 months after the end of the fiscal year, e.g. by March 31 for calendar-year entities. Interim return: within 2 months after the end of the first 6 months of the fiscal year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year-end date and corporate registration information.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Korean business registration number of the Yuhan Hoesa and confirm the domestic fiscal year dates. Non-resident shareholders are not recorded on this line; their ownership details appear in Schedule of Non-Resident Shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenue from real estate rental, asset management, and other REIT operating receipts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross Korean-source revenue only; do not net management fees or expenses. Non-resident investors must ensure withholding on distributions is tracked on the distribution schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions for operating expenses, depreciation, interest, and amortization of capital costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only expenses supported by valid tax invoices or accounting records. Related-party expense deductions must satisfy arm's length and economic substance requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income before special deductions and REIT distribution deduction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute domestic-source taxable income in KRW. If the REIT is owned by non-residents, ensure no treaty override is claimed at the entity level; treaty relief is generally applied at shareholder withholding level.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: REIT distributable income deduction and other statutory deductions from taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the qualifying dividend distribution deduction under the Corporate Tax Act, preserving contemporaneous board minutes and dividend payment proof. Non-resident shareholders remain subject to withholding under the Income Tax Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed tax before credits, using the progressive CIT rate schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply KRW-denominated rates exactly. Foreign tax credits, if any, are generally unavailable for pure Korean-source REIT income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits, advance payments, interim payments, and net tax payable after withholding credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credit previously paid interim tax installments. Non-resident withholding taxes on dividends distributed during the tax year should not reduce entity-level CIT unless statutorily allowed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or non-filing of the corporate tax return triggers a failure-to-file additional tax equal to 20% of the unpaid tax where no justifiable cause exists; fraudulent underreporting triggers a 40% additional tax, and simple underreporting triggers 10%. A late payment surcharge of 1.2% per month, pro-rated daily, applies from the due date to the payment date, subject to a maximum accumulation period of 36 months. Interest on deferred tax and penalty interest may also be assessed by the National Tax Service.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 22% statutory withholding on dividends paid to a non-resident corporation or non-resident individual, composed of 20% national income tax and 2% local income tax surcharge. Dividend payments to Korean resident shareholders are subject to 15.4% withholding under the Income Tax Act. A qualifying REIT distribution does not eliminate shareholder-level withholding.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a reduced Korea tax treaty rate, the non-resident beneficial owner must submit a TRC (Certificate of Tax Residence) issued by the home country tax authority and an Application for Tax Treaty Exemption or Abatement to the Korean withholding agent or the National Tax Service before or at the time of dividend payment. The applicant must establish beneficial ownership, demonstrate active substance in the residence jurisdiction, and provide relevant constitutional documents. The NTS reserves the right to apply substance-over-form, beneficial ownership, and anti-conduit analysis before granting treaty relief.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding for cross-border royalty and interest income paid to a non-resident is 22%: 20% national corporate/income tax plus 2% local surcharge. Under many Korean tax treaties, interest may be reduced to 10-15% and royalties to 10-15%, often conditioned on beneficial ownership and on withholding tax submission procedures. Royalties paid for the use of trademarks, patents, real estate valuation algorithms, or property management intellectual property must be separately disclosed and supported by a license agreement.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File and Master File preparation and filing are mandatory where cross-border related-party transactions of the Korean entity exceed KRW 50 billion in a fiscal year. A Country-by-Country Report is required where the consolidated group revenue of the ultimate parent reaches KRW 100 billion. Even below these thresholds, the Korea National Tax Service may require contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation where margin anomalies or financing arrangements are present.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Korea does not apply Gulf-Caribbean style Economic Substance Regulations, but it applies strict economic substance principles through the Framework Act on National Taxes, the Corporate Tax Act anti-avoidance rules, beneficial ownership tests, and OECD BEPS anti-conduit doctrines. A Yuhan Hoesa REIT must maintain real presence in Korea: registered Korean office, local directors or officers, physical or verifiable operating records, independent financial statements, actual investment and asset-management decisions, legal title to Korean real estate, and compliance with the Real Estate Investment Company Act. Substance-less structures will be denied treaty benefits and may face reassessment, penalty tax, license revocation, and criminal investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting rental or real estate disposal income, overstating acquisition or construction costs, fabricating expense invoices, misclassifying shareholder distributions as management fees, and failing to file corporate tax returns in the name of the Yuhan Hoesa.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Framework Act on National Taxes, fraudulent underreports trigger a 40% penalty additional tax and late payment surcharge of 1.2% per month; under the Punishment of Tax Offenses Act, tax evasion is punishable by imprisonment for up to 5 years or a criminal fine of up to KRW 100 million, with aggravated economic crime penalties possible for large amounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow beneficial owners may be jointly and severally liable for unpaid corporate taxes and penalties; the corporate veil may be pierced where the company is an alter ego or nominee vehicle. Personal consequences include civil restitution, asset attachment, travel bans, mandatory appearance orders, and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company, Economic Substance Deficiency, and Treaty Shopping
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Yuhan Hoesa with no real Korean office, no local management, no REIT license, no actual real estate investment activity, and using nominee shareholders solely to access Korea tax treaty withholding benefits or dividend-paid deduction without bona fide business substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The National Tax Service will deny treaty withholding reductions, impose the full 22% statutory withholding rate, disallow the REIT income distribution deduction, and may assess up to 40% additional tax plus overdue surcharges. The Financial Services Commission may revoke the REIT registration or license and order termination of unlawful trust activities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who execute false substance certifications, sign inaccurate resident certificates, or authorize conduit structures are personally liable for the resulting tax deficits and penalties. They face civil restitution to investors, travel bans, disqualification from serving as licensed REIT directors, and criminal prosecution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT and Unlicensed Real Estate Investment Trust Activity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting investor capital and conducting income-generating real estate trust activity without the required statutory REIT or trust license; failing to file Suspicious Transaction Reports on abnormal ACH or wire transfers; laundering proceeds of digital-content fraud or gaming-related illegal proceeds through dividend distributions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act, unlicensed REIT/trust activity is punishable by imprisonment for up to 5 years or by a criminal fine of up to KRW 200 million, or both; failure to comply with the Specified Financial Information Act STR regime may result in imprisonment up to 3 years and fines up to KRW 50 million.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers who knowingly manage an unlicensed REIT or permit money laundering through the trust are criminally liable, individually subject to asset forfeiture, freezing orders, travel bans, and imprisonment; they may also be required to personally compensate investors for losses caused by unlawful trust management.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Non-Disclosure and Misallocation of Income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Setting below-market rental or asset management fees with foreign related parties, failing to file the Local File and Master File after exceeding the KRW 50 billion threshold, engaging in undocumented cross-border shareholder loans, and failing to provide an arm's length functional and economic analysis.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Korean tax authorities may reassess related-party income under the arm's length principle, disallow inflated deductions, impose interest and additional tax for underreported taxable income, and penalize failure to submit mandatory transfer pricing documentation. The penalty and interest can reach 40% of the adjusted income when combined with fraudulent understatement rules.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve transfer pricing policies without adequate documentation may be personally liable for the resulting corporate tax shortage if they knew or recklessly disregarded the non-arm's length structure; they face civil liability to the company and shareholders, arrest and travel bans, and criminal exposure for falsifying tax documents.
